definitions.explanation: The state of a bill, fee, or debt having already been paid in full. Often marked on invoices and receipts.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{請求書|せいきゅうしょ}→請求書：04698_seikyuusho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{支払|しはら}い{済|ず}みだ。
{支払|しはら}い{済|ず}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}→領収書：04697_ryoushuusho⟧。
⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すでに{支払|しはら}い{済|ず}みな⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{追加|ついか}→追加：04060_tsuika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{請求|せいきゅう}→請求：03374_seikyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: The fee has already been paid, so there will be no additional charge.

notes:
⟦{済|ず}み→〜済み：04013_zumi⟧ is a suffix meaning "finished, already done," attached to many nouns and verb stems.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {支払|しはら}い{済|ず}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{請求書|せいきゅうしょ}→請求書：04698_seikyuusho⟧: paid invoice
- {支払|しはら}い{済|ず}み⟦マーク→マーク：09478_maaku⟧: "paid" stamp

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{未払|みばら}い→未払い：18029_mibarai⟧: unpaid — the antonym
- ⟦{入金済|にゅうきんず}み→入金済み：30049_nyuukinzumi⟧: payment received — the same state seen from the recipient's side
